title: Introduction to French Phonetics and Phonology
modules: Description Phonologique Des Phonèmes Vocaliques Du
Les Principes De Liaison En Français
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are described according to their features."
Phonemes are described according to their features.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major element of pronunciation in French language."
Intonation is a major element of pronunciation in French language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a gap between two vowels which needs to be filled."
A hiatus is a gap between two vowels which needs to be filled.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a typical sound change process by which the phonetics of a speech segment becomes more like that of another segment in a word (or at a word boundary), so that a change of phoneme occurs."

Assimilation is a typical sound change process by which the phonetics of a speech segment becomes more like that of another segment in a word (or at a word boundary), so that a change of phoneme occurs.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a component of generative grammar that assigns the correct phonetic representations to utterances in such a way as to reflect a native speaker's internalized grammar."
Generative phonology is a component of generative grammar that assigns the correct phonetic representations to utterances in such a way as to reflect a native speaker's internalized grammar.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the set of stages used to generate the phonetic representation of a word from its underlying representation."
A Phonological derivation is the set of stages used to generate the phonetic representation of a word from its underlying representation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the putting together of all the features that characterize a given segment."
A matrix is the putting together of all the features that characterize a given segment.
fib: ______ are those features that distinguish phonemes between themselves.
Distinctive features
Distinctive features are those features that distinguish phonemes between themselves.
______ is the description of the systems and patterns of sounds that occur in a language. (La phonologie est l'étude des sons en tant qu'unités distinctives de sens.
Phonology
Phonology is the description of the systems and patterns of sounds that occur in a language. (La phonologie est l'étude des sons en tant qu'unités distinctives de sens.
______ is the process of cutting words into syllables.
Syllabification
Syllabification is the process of cutting words into syllables.
______ is the smallest unit of meaning in a language.
morpheme
A morpheme is the smallest unit of meaning in a language.
______ means that a liaison must take place between two words, provided they satisfy the criteria : 3.
Compulsory liaison (liaison obligatoire)
Compulsory liaison
Compulsory liaison (liaison obligatoire) means that a liaison must take place between two words, provided they satisfy the criteria : 3.
______ is a minimal phonetic unit contained in a matrix that defines a segment.
feature
A feature is a minimal phonetic unit contained in a matrix that defines a segment.
______ is the study of the phonological structure of morphemes (l'étude des moyens phonologiques mis au service de la morphologie).
Morphonology
Morphonology is the study of the phonological structure of morphemes (l'étude des moyens phonologiques mis au service de la morphologie).
